messages:
alex_chen: Quick sync — we need to sequence the Optimize toolkit work: quantization, batching, caching. Customer pressure from FinCorp and two other mid-market accounts asking for 2-3x token cost reductions. I sketched a RICE to start. Thoughts?

sandeep: thanks — can you paste the RICE? my primary concern is quantization ripple: model accuracy regressions need evals and a ton of infra changes. not trivial. :thinking_face:

maria_g: agree with @sandeep. batching is lower risk but has infra/runtime work (scheduler + KV interactions). caching (prefix/KV) is highest ROI for chat-like workloads.

alex_chen: pasted below — rough numbers, please challenge.
```
Feature    Reach Impact Confidence Effort  R*I/C Score
Caching    7     8      0.8        3       14.7
Batching   6     6      0.7        4       6.3
Quantize   5     9      0.5        8       2.8
```

kevin_b: small nit: effort scale is 1-10 where 1 is cheapest. numbers look fine. but quantization effort includes: kernel changes, new compile paths, QA matrices for 6 model families. estimate = 7-9 not 8 depending on model scope.

lucy_se: from SE/customer side: FinCorp will accept caching+batching first if we can show 30-40% cost reduction and no output drift. they only asked for quantization as long-term. we should surface launch criteria for each feature.

anna_cs: also hearing from PharmaCo (private deployment) — they want deterministic latency and smaller model footprints (quantization matters for on-prem). so enterprise customers are split.

maria_g: proposal: 1) Ship caching MVP (prefix KV cache + TTLs, per-customer opt-in) — low runtime churn, easy experiments. 2) Improve batching scheduler (dynamic batching heuristics + per-tenant caps) — medium effort. 3) Run quantization pilots in parallel with a small model family (Llama2-13B) with eval harness and rollback paths.

sandeep: +1. for quantization pilots we need a strict launch checklist: a) eval set + automated diff alerts, b) fallback to FP model via routing policy, c) perf/cost dashboard.

alex_chen: suggested launch criteria (MVP each):
- Caching MVP: >25% token-cost reduction on chat workloads for top 5 customers, <3% increase in tail-latency 95p, opt-in flag.
- Batching MVP: 10-20% cost improvement on throughput-heavy routes, latency SLO <= 250ms p95 for latency-sensitive routes.
- Quantize pilot: >=30% per-token cost drop on dedicated infra, no more than 2% quality regression on eval set; auto-rollout guardrails.

kevin_b: technical risk callout: caching changes affect KV cache lifecycle and invalidation — SRE and runtime need playbook for cache-related incidents.

lucy_se: can we bundle batching + caching in a single pilot for FinCorp? they'd prefer one deploy if it reduces cost faster.

maria_g: bundling is doable but increases blast radius. recommend sequential: caching can be toggled per-tenant; enable caching first, run for 2 weeks, then flip batching for same tenant. easier rollback.

alex_chen: decision leaning: prioritize caching MVP (2-week internal + 2-week customer pilot), then batching, while starting quantization pilots in parallel but gated. I'll write PRD with RICE + launch criteria. anyone strongly opposed?

sandeep: no strong opposition. please include acceptance tests for model quality and a rollback path in PRD.

kevin_b: add SRE runbook + deploy-bot integration for cache TTL changes.

deploy-bot: scheduled: caching-mvp/branch -> staging at 2026-04-08T10:00Z if PRD posted. :robot_face:

alex_chen: cool — I'll post the PRD by EOD and tag owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:
